code='''def transform(grid):
    # Copy the non-background pattern from one compartment into every
    # compartment of the same size, leaving divider lines intact.
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=9
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    hcuts=[-1]+[r for r in range(h) if all(v==3 for v in g[r])]+[h]
    wcuts=[-1]+[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==3 for r in range(h))]+[w]

    colspans=[(wcuts[i]+1,wcuts[i+1]) for i in range(len(wcuts)-1)]
    # Find a compartment containing colored content and use its local pattern.
    source=None
    for r0,r1 in rowspans:
        for c0,c1 in colspans:
            pat=[row[c0:c1] for row in g[r0:r1]]
            if any(v!=bg for row in pat for v in row):
                source=pat

        if source is not None: break

    for r0,r1 in rowspans:

            if r1-r0==len(source) and c1-c0==len(source[0]):
                for i in range(len(source)):
                    g[r0+i][c0:c1]=source[i][:]
    return g
'''
